reviews.title: A great starter light for content creation!
reviews.comment: When I first started recording videos, I didn't have any kind of lighting. Which I quickly realized was a problem. So when I was browsing Amazon for some good lights I came across this. It had pretty good reviews and seemed reliable. After considering that I decided to buy it. I'm glad I did. Very easy set up. Simple to use and adjust. Has a decent amount of light settings. At max setting it is very bright. Sits perfectly on top of my main monitor. Cord length is rather long. Giving it a bit of versatility on where you can place it. Definitely a good price for the level of quality. I highly recommend this light.
reviews.author: Larry Kimmel

reviews.title: Makes a Bigger Difference Than I Expected
reviews.comment: I wasn’t sure how much a small light would actually help, but this one really surprised me. It gives off a soft, even light that makes everything look clearer without being harsh or blinding. Setup was easy, and I like how simple it is to adjust the brightness and warmth depending on the time of day. It sits nicely on my desk and doesn’t feel bulky. I’ve mostly been using it for video calls and the occasional recording, and it just makes things look more polished without much effort. Nothing complicated, it just works really well.
reviews.author: Bill Welcher

reviews.title: Very Good Addition for Video Meetings / Streaming
reviews.comment: Ambient lights are just not satisfactory for video conferencing.  So I bought the Logitech  LED Streaming Light to bring my face out of the shadows (so to speak).  The device serves that purpose well. It connects to a USB-A port, so is easily used on a computer, but less easily used on iPads or phones.  For devices without USB-A ports, I use a power brick.  The LEDs do not draw much power so won't draw down batteries by much during use. The light itself is adjustable in intensity and color.  The adjustability helps it provide good, even illumination in a way that is not distracting to viewers.  Further, the mount is adjustable both vertically and pivoting to angle so as to avoid strang reflections from my glasses or sharp shadowing. I give it 4 stars only because it is a competing light-source to my screen.  This cannot be avoided, I think, without illuminating the entire room.  Perhaps a backlight would help.  Nevertheless, this is a fine product and serves my needs well.  Definitely worth the price.
reviews.author: Bill in CT

reviews.title: Logitech for Creators Litra Glow Premium: A Great Value for the Money!
reviews.comment: This light source is an excellent addition to any Videoconferencing setup. It is automatically detected by the Ghub app if you have it previously installed on your PC and it was instantly working on my PC within a minute of connecting the included USB cable and hanging it on my monitor. The controller software in the Ghub app is extremely easy to use and it is more convenient than manually adjusting the controls on the light when it is hanging on your monitor. The software has numerous presets for adjusting the color temperature and intensity of the light simultaneously. All-in-all I am very pleased with my purchase from Amazon and I consider the light to be a good value for the money.
reviews.author: MTR

reviews.title: An exceptional product for a reasonable price
reviews.comment: I was a little concerned after reading reviews on this light.  Some of the reviews are just incorrect. First, the design: I have a large curved monitor with a small bezel and a curved back panel.  I had a tough time finding a webcam that would work with this monitor, so I expected to have trouble installing this light.  Not a problem at all.  I could put it anywhere on the top of the monitor with no problem.  I chose to move it off to one side to create more pleasing shadows while its on. Next: usability.  There are buttons on the back for power, color temperature and brightness of the light.  Easy to control manually.  You can also control the light via software.  This is where it gets awesome.  You can manually set the light from the software, which is not a huge benefit.  On the other hand, you can configure it to turn on when you open specific applications and you can configure the light qualities (color temp and brightness) by application.  I only use this light with Zoom and Teams, so I configured it to turn on when those apps are opened.  Now I don't need to remember to reach up and turn the light on when meetings begin.  I believe the light can also be controlled via a logitech keyboard, but I cannot confirm because I use an Apple keyboard. Finally: light quality.  The light panel is about 4"x4".  The larger the panel, the softer the light.  This light is nicely diffused, but if it were just a bit larger, the light quality would be better.  I'm not complaining at all.  Just be prepared that the shadows aren't super-soft.  Not a big deal for me. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: K. Keller
